title: Design: A/R Collection chevrons and pinned group row look as described
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The report has open documents in several customer groups on today's date, one with more lines than fit on the screen.
  • Starting screen: A/R Collection (Reports, then "A/R Aging Collection" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu in light theme at 100% zoom, with every group collapsed.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Look at the table's top-left header cell.
  2. Look at each customer group row's own chevron.
  3. Hover over the top-left chevron button.
  4. Click it, then hover over it again.
  5. Scroll down through the tallest customer group.
  6. Switch ShopView to dark theme.
  7. Hover over the top-left chevron button.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: one chevron button, the design system's chevron icon, in the top-left header cell, pointing right (every group collapsed).
  • Step 2: every customer group row shows the same chevron, pointing right when closed.
  • Step 3: a tooltip above the button reads "Expand all", letter for letter.
  • Step 4: every customer group opens, its chevron points down, and the tooltip above the button reads "Collapse all".
  • Step 5: the customer group's row stays pinned just under the column headings, with its label visible at the left.
  • Step 6: the page switches to dark theme; the pinned row is readable.
  • Step 7: the tooltip sits above the button and is readable in dark theme.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11534 (Story 4, Collapse all, Expand all and pinned group rows)

  • S4-R1: “The table's top-left header cell holds one chevron button. While any group is expanded it points down, its tooltip (above the button) reads "Collapse all", and a click collapses every group. When every group is collapsed it points right, its tooltip reads "Expand all", and a click expands every group.”
  • S4-R5: “Each group's own expand toggle uses the same chevron: pointing down when open, right when closed. Behavior is unchanged.”
  • S4-R6: “While the user scrolls through an expanded group, that group's row (the bucket label, customer or vendor) stays pinned just under the column headings. Only one group row is held at a time: when the next group's row reaches it, the next row pushes it up and off and takes its place. Scrolling back reverses this.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Collapse all / Expand all button | "Collapse all" / "Expand all" | Tooltip above the button”
  • Key Decisions, reuse rule: “The reuse rule. Every control on these reports reuses an existing ShopView pattern: the native filter chips, the native totals row and pinned headline column of the newer reports, the existing location-switch prompt, the design system's chevron icon. Nothing new is drawn. Basis: d-reuse-existing-pattern.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), read 22 Oct 2026: page 3 "Collapse all and pinned group rows" (board Grouped.dc.html); page 6 "Descriptions and pinned column" (board Layout.dc.html). The design shows the chevrons and the pinned row; the Collapse all / Expand all tooltip is not drawn.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ar-ap-p6-info-icon-beside-the-title-light.png: figure "Info icon beside the title, light" (This build (after)), board "6. Report descriptions and the pinned headline column"
  • ar-ap-p3-expand-all-from-the-header.png: figure "Expand all from the header" (This build (after)), board "3. Collapse all, Expand all and pinned group rows"
  • ar-ap-p3-the-customer-row-stays-pinned.png: figure "The customer row stays pinned" (This build (after)), board "3. Collapse all, Expand all and pinned group rows"
  • ar-ap-p7-a-r-collection-date-and-customer-only.png: figure "A/R Collection, groups opened one by one" (Production (before)), board "3. Collapse all, Expand all and pinned group rows" (today's look, for comparison only)

The design's own words:

  • "The native report info icon sits right of the title; title, icon and ⋯ stay on one line, filter row below. S8-R1, S8-R2." (caption of "Info icon beside the title, light")
  • "One chevron in the top-left header cell: "Collapse all" while any group is open, "Expand all" when none is. Group toggles use the same chevron. S4-R1 to S4-R5, S4-R8." (caption of "Expand all from the header")
  • "While scrolling a group, its row stays under the column headings; the next group's row pushes it up and off. S4-R6." (caption of "The customer row stays pinned")
  • "Each customer opens with its own arrow; there is no way to open or close them all." (caption of "A/R Collection, groups opened one by one")
